note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording and the self-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. OWB's inner quotation marks become ‹› inside the book's «». Heb 2:9 (§10) joins OWB pieces around its 'apart from God' (χωρὶς θεοῦ), where Athanasius reads 'by the grace of God'. Isa 7:14 (§33) is quoted as Matthew 1:23 gives it ('the virgin', with its 'God with us'), Hos 11:1 as Matthew 2:15, Isa 11:10 (§35) as Romans 15:12. §56's 'in the glory of the Father' (from Matt 16:27) is not in OWB Matt 26:64 and is dropped. John 3:3 (§14) is OWB 'born from above' with the gloss (ማለትም ዳግመኛ ካልተወለደ).

Athanasius quotes the Greek Old Testament (Septuagint). Where OWB's wording serves his point, the quotation is OWB. Where his argument rests on the Septuagint's own wording (Gen 2:17 'dying ye shall die'; Num 24:7, 24:17 'a man'; Isa 8:4; Isa 53:8-9 'who shall declare his generation'; Deut 28:66 'your Life hanging'; Jer 11:19 'a tree upon his bread'; Ps 22:16 'they pierced'; Dan 9:24-25 'a Holy of Holies'; Gen 49:10 'the expectation of the nations'; Isa 63:9 'the Lord Himself'), the translator's rendering of the Septuagint stands, self_rendered with the reason in `why`. Wisdom of Solomon (§4, §5) is outside OWB.
Other `self_rendered` rows are allusions or paraphrases in the author's own sentence. Translations of this book are ai_unreviewed until a reviewer approves them.
